description: Remote data the app only caches. It can be stale, shared and invalidated, unlike state you fully own.
The identifier of a cached query. Equal keys share one cache entry and one request.
Serving cached data immediately while refetching in the background to refresh it.
Marking cached queries stale, usually after a mutation, so the next reader refetches.
`@tanstack/angular-query-experimental` is labelled experimental, so its API may change in minor and patch versions.
